who: Runs a four-person brand studio with a partner. Has an agent draft the first pass of every proposal and reads each line before it goes. Two children, one school run.

moments.plot: The orchard co-op wants the rebrand proposal on Friday, and the school fair needs a stall.

tasks.title: Finish the co-op proposal
tasks.notes: Three routes, one price each. Baptiste thinks two routes is braver.

tasks.title: Plan the workshop with the growers
tasks.notes: Half of them pick apples until noon. Afternoon, in the packing shed.

tasks.title: Pull the old labels from the archive
Write what the price does not cover
Kickoff call with the co-op board
Ask the co-op for their sales figures
Ask Ines what the stall needs

file.title: Ask the accountant about the deposit
file.notes: Half up front, or a third? Baptiste says a third scares nobody.

dated.title: Send the proposal
dated.notes: PDF and a short note. Ines reads it before it goes.

repeating.title: Studio money check
repeating.notes: Cash, what is owed, what is late.

attachments.notes: Labels from 1962, 1988 and the one with the bee. Ask the board before we scan the bee.

tasks.title: Sign up for the fair rota

agent.title: Turn the workshop notes into three routes
agent.notes: Forty minutes of growers talking. Keep their words, not ours.
agent.question: How far should the routes go?
bodies: All three routes keep the old bee and the hand lettering. They differ in colour and in how much of the orchard shows.
Route one stays near the old labels. Route two drops the bee and leads with the orchard map. Route three sits between them.
agent.otherBody: Three routes, built from the growers’ own words. Your direction: {answer}
agent.acceptance: You can pick the routes for the proposal.

discuss.title: Answer the co-op about the budget
discuss.notes: They asked if we can do it for less. Ines says yes to less work, never to a lower rate.
discuss.question: What do you want to offer?
bodies: Thank you for being open about the budget. We can do it for less by showing two routes instead of three. The rate stays the same.
Thank you for being open about the budget. We can keep the full scope and spread the fee over two years, in four parts.
discuss.otherBody: Thank you for being open about the budget. Here is what we can do: {answer}
discuss.otherAnswer: Drop the workshop, keep the routes
discuss.handoff: Your next step: send it after lunch
discuss.acceptance: The co-op knows what the budget buys.

review.title: Turn the workshop notes into three routes
review.note: Three routes, each with the grower quote it came from.

review.title: Sort the studio receipts by client
review.note: Forty-one receipts. Six have no client yet.

faded: Book the type fair in Lisbon
Give a talk at the art school
